answer: Every epoch charges the same 214 POA again, so 806 masks cost the farm 172484 POA all over again. The farm counts its saffron as a win, its crystal as an expense, its harbor as a nuisance — and the nuisance is the one it cannot buy off. Proof, not promises: Bran sifter rice bran milled at the sifting loft asks for each rice is a measured grain yield plus a miller's signature, and no farm can supply it honestly. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone.
